name: Masan Group Corporation
summary: Masan Group Corporation, an investment holding company, manufactures and distributes food and beverage products in Vietnam and internationally. It operates in five segments: Branded Consumer Products; MEATLife; High-Tech Materials; Consumer Retail; and Others. The company offers soya sauce, fish sauce, seasoning, chili sauce, instant noodles, instant congee, instant coffee, instant cereals, bottled beverages, processed meat, and beer, as well as washing powder, liquid detergent, dishwashing liquid, and body wash.
